relics.name: Relic of the Fractal
relics.description: When you inflict bleeding on an enemy with 6 or more stacks of bleeding, also inflict burning and torment.

relics.name: Relic of the Thief
relics.description: Upon striking an enemy with a weapon skill that has a recharge or resource cost, gain increased strike damage. When this triggers, refresh the duration of all stacks.

relics.name: Relic of Akeem
relics.description: When you disable an enemy that is afflicted by 5 or more stacks of confusion or torment, inflict confusion and torment on enemies around the target.

relics.name: Relic of Vass
relics.description: After using a healing or elixir skill, your next few attacks inflict poison. Healing skills can only trigger this effect once every interval.

relics.name: Relic of the Astral Ward
relics.description: Gain a Signet of the Astral Ward after using a signet skill. Using a signet skill while this signet is active consumes it to remove conditions from nearby allies and grant them resistance.

relics.name: Relic of the Afflicted
relics.description: Create a Death Nova at a foe's location upon their defeat that inflicts poison and bleeding. (Cooldown: 10 Seconds)

relics.name: Relic of Nayos
relics.description: Removing a condition from yourself heals you.

relics.name: Relic of Peitha
relics.description: After shadowstepping or using a deception skill, fire a blade at a nearby enemy after a short delay, applying torment and increasing your strike damage against that target.

relics.name: Relic of Cerus
relics.description: Upon using an elite skill, summon an Eye of Cerus that emits a rotating line attack, dealing damage and converting boons into conditions.

relics.name: Relic of Isgarren
relics.description: After evading an enemy's attack, place the Eye of Isgarren on them for a duration. You deal increased strike and condition duration against enemies with the Eye of Isgarren.

relics.name: Relic of the Herald
relics.description: Gain concentration after granting a boon to an ally.

relics.name: Relic of Durability
relics.description: Gain protection and regeneration after using a healing skill.

relics.name: Relic of the Aristocracy
relics.description: Gain 3% condition duration for 8 seconds when inflicting weakness or vulnerability on a foe, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. (Cooldown: 1 Second)

relics.name: Relic of the Adventurer
relics.description: Gain 50% endurance after using a healing skill. (Cooldown: 20 Seconds)

relics.name: Relic of the Wizard's Tower
relics.description: After using an elite skill, shield yourself with a projectile-reflecting barrier while summoning a wave that pulls enemies toward you.

relics.name: Relic of Antitoxin
relics.description: Outgoing condition cleanses remove an additional condition. This can only affect an ally once every 10 seconds.

relics.name: Relic of the Doyen
relics.description: Take reduced incoming strike damage while you have resolution. This does not stack with other sources of the same effect.

relics.name: Relic of the Citadel
relics.description: After using an elite skill, call down an artillery strike that inflicts stun on the skill target or nearest enemy.

relics.name: Relic of the Zephyrite
relics.description: Summon crystals that apply protection and resolution to allies after using an elite skill. Crystal duration scales with the recharge of the used skill.

relics.name: Relic of Watch
relics.description: Immobilization you inflict lasts longer. Weaken foes when you immobilize them.

relics.name: Relic of the Cruel Overseer
relics.description: Gain stacks of Kuda's Cruelty when you inflict damaging conditions. After reaching the maximum number of stacks, convert outgoing condition damage into healing for a short period of time.

relics.name: Relic of Galdra
relics.description: When you use an elite skill, launch projectiles that inflict burning at nearby foes.

relics.name: Relic of the Sacred Grounds
relics.description: Gain protection when you use a well or consecration skill.

relics.name: Relic of the Director
relics.description: Inflict vulnerability on nearby enemies when you use a healing skill. For a short period of time, you deal increased damage to vulnerable foes.

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Impact
sigils.effect:
+7% Strike Damage vs. Stunned or Knocked-Down Foes
+3% Strike Damage

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Frailty
sigils.effect: Inflict 2 stacks of vulnerability for 8 seconds after striking a foe from behind or the flank or when they are defiant. <c=@reminder>(Cooldown: 2 seconds)</c>

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Bloodlust
sigils.effect:
Gain a charge of +10 power each time you kill a foe, five charges if you kill an enemy player. (Max 25 stacks; ends on down.)
(Only one attribute-stacking sigil can be active at a time.)

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Doom
sigils.effect:
Your next attack will inflict 3 stacks of poison for 8 seconds after swapping to this weapon in combat.
(Cooldown: 9 Seconds)

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Cruelty
sigils.effect:
Gain a charge of +10 ferocity each time you kill a foe, five charges if you kill an enemy player. (Max 25 stacks; ends on down.)
(Only one attribute-stacking sigil can be active at a time.)

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Transference
sigils.effect: Healing to other allies is increased by 10%.

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Water
sigils.effect:
Heal allies within a 360 radius of your target upon landing a critical hit.
(Cooldown: 5 Seconds)

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Generosity
sigils.effect:
Transfer a condition upon critically hitting a foe.
(Cooldown: 6 Seconds)

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Energy
sigils.effect: Gain 50% of your endurance when you swap to this weapon while in combat. <c=@reminder>(Cooldown: 9 Seconds)</c>

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Cleansing
sigils.effect: Remove 3 conditions when swapping to this weapon in combat. <c=@reminder>(Cooldown: 9 Seconds)</c>

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Absorption
sigils.effect: Steal 3 boons when interrupting a foe. <c=@reminder>(Cooldown: 10 seconds) (Cooldown against defiant foes: 3 seconds)</c>

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of Battle
sigils.effect: Gain 5 stacks of might for 12 seconds when swapping to this weapon in combat. (Cooldown: 9 Seconds)

sigils.name: Superior Sigil of the Night
sigils.effect: Outgoing damage is increased by 3% with an additional 7% at night.

runes.name: Superior Rune of the Scholar
runes.sixthBonus: +10% Schaden, während die eigene Gesundheit über 90% liegt.

runes.name: Superior Rune of the Krait
runes.sixthBonus: +10% Zustandsschaden gegen Gegner über 90% Gesundheit UND gegen Gegner unter 33% Gesundheit.

runes.name: Superior Rune of the Eagle
runes.sixthBonus: +10% kritischer Schaden gegen Gegner auf mehr als 600 Entfernung.

runes.name: Superior Rune of Fireworks
runes.sixthBonus: Bei Nutzung einer Fähigkeit mit ≥20s Abklingzeit: +7% Schaden für 6s (Stack erneuert Dauer).

runes.name: Superior Rune of the Thief
runes.sixthBonus: Verdeckte Angriffe (Stealth Attacks) verursachen 15% mehr Schaden.

runes.name: Superior Rune of Leadership
runes.sixthBonus: Beim Einsatz eines Banners oder Signets: +33% Segensdauer für alle Verbündeten in der Nähe für 10s.

runes.name: Superior Rune of the Herald
runes.sixthBonus: Beim Aktivieren einer Legende: übertrage einen zufälligen Segen von dir auf nahe Verbündete.

runes.name: Superior Rune of the Aristocracy
runes.sixthBonus: Bei kritischem Treffer: Regeneration für dich und nahe Verbündete.

runes.name: Superior Rune of the Monk
runes.sixthBonus: Beim Einsatz eines Heilskills: Schaden von Symbolen/Brunnen erhöht.

runes.name: Superior Rune of the Trooper
runes.sixthBonus: Beim Einsatz eines Shouts: entferne einen Zustand von dir.

runes.name: Superior Rune of Antitoxin
runes.sixthBonus: Beim Entfernen eines Zustands: erhalte Regeneration.

runes.name: Superior Rune of Balthazar
runes.sixthBonus: 7% Chance bei kritischem Treffer, den Gegner brennen zu lassen; erhöhte Brenndauer.

runes.name: Superior Rune of the Pack
runes.sixthBonus: Beim Einsatz eines Shouts: Raserei, Schnelligkeit und Kraft für dich und nahe Verbündete.

runes.name: Superior Rune of Durability
runes.sixthBonus: Beim Erhalt von Stabilität: kurzzeitig erhöhte Zähigkeit für dich und nahe Verbündete.

runes.name: Superior Rune of Vampirism
runes.sixthBonus: Angriffe entziehen dem Ziel Leben (Life Steal) und heilen dich.

runes.name: Superior Rune of Speed
runes.sixthBonus: Am Ende der Ausweichrolle: kurze Schnelligkeit.
